name: spirv-tools
description: Libraries and utilities for processing SPIR-V modules.
build: cd SPIRV-Tools-vulkan-sdk-1.4.341.0 && mkdir -p build && cd build && cmake -D CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=/usr -D CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -D SPIRV_WERROR=OFF -D BUILD_SHARED_LIBS=ON -D SPIRV_TOOLS_BUILD_STATIC=OFF -D SPIRV-Headers_SOURCE_DIR=/usr -G Ninja .. && ninja $MAKEOPTS
